3/n Nobody is objectively using #Ethereum for DeFi applications. What gives value to networks like #Bitcoin, Ethereum and #Dogecoin is the size of their networks.

If you want to find winners now, find the ones that have the potential to grow FAST.

3/n #Dogecoin, #Pancakeswap, #Cardano have been among the fastest growing communities on reddit and price growth is also top percentile. 

Meanwhile, #Tezos, #Litecoin, and to some extent #Etereum have had slower growth in terms of community, and price has been somewhat lagging https://t.co/zXsVh99yij

Do do you see a pattern ?
